_comment: The compose-ai-tools Gradle plugin coordinate this extension is built against.
In the monorepo this was derived from .release-please-manifest.json, which only
worked because the plugin and the extension shared a version and a release train.
Split apart they do not, so the compatibility pin is explicit and reviewable here.
`composeAiPlugin` is the version scripts/generate-version.mjs bakes into
BUNDLED_PLUGIN_VERSION — what the extension asks Gradle to apply when it injects
the plugin into a user's build. Bump it in its own PR when adopting a new plugin
release, so the adoption is a reviewable change rather than a side effect of a
release train. The PLUGIN_VERSION env var still overrides it for release builds
and for a local loop against a mavenLocal SNAPSHOT.
`composePreviewDaemon` is NOT a second choice — it is the daemon release that the
plugin named above resolves, written down so this repository can fetch from the
right place. Since compose-ai-tools extracted the daemon into
yschimke/compose-preview-daemon (its own 3.x train), the protocol fixtures and the
daemon wire live there, at a tag that has nothing to do with the plugin's version.
Every compose-ai-tools POM imports `compose-preview-daemon-bom` at this version, so
it is a published fact rather than a judgement: scripts/check-daemon-pin.mjs reads
it back out of `render-host-<composeAiPlugin>.pom` on Maven Central and fails if
the two have skewed. Bump it only to whatever that POM says.
`daemon-launch-builder` stayed in compose-ai-tools and is still versioned with the
plugin, so scripts/check-daemon-launch-schema.mjs keeps reading it at
`composeAiPlugin`.
